name: Plain chicken rice bowl
summary: Boiled rice with a simply seasoned pan-fried chicken breast and steamed broccoli and carrot.
method: Rinse the dry rice, then boil it in plenty of water for 10 to 12 minutes until tender and drain well.

Meanwhile, season the chicken breast with the salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes on each side until cooked through, then rest it for 2 minutes and slice.
Steam the broccoli and the sliced carrot for 4 to 5 minutes until just tender.
Put the rice in a bowl with the chicken and vegetables, and add the soy sauce or lemon juice if you like.
notes: Easy to cook in bulk for packed lunches: keep the rice and chicken chilled and eat within 3 days.

name: Egg fried rice
summary: Leftover rice stir-fried with egg, peas and spring onions, seasoned with soy sauce and sesame oil.
method: Beat the eggs in a bowl. Slice the spring onions, keeping the white and green parts apart, and crush the garlic.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat, pour in the eggs and stir for 30 to 60 seconds until just set, then tip onto a plate.

Add the rest of the oil, the garlic and the white spring onion and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add the cold cooked rice and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, breaking up any clumps, adding the frozen peas for the last 2 minutes.
Return the eggs, add the soy sauce and sesame oil, toss well and scatter over the green spring onion.
notes: Made with cold leftover rice, which fries without clumping. About 140 g dry rice cooks to roughly 400 g.

name: Chicken fried rice
summary: Egg fried rice made into a main with stir-fried pieces of chicken breast.
method: Cut the chicken breast into small pieces. Beat the egg, slice the spring onions and crush the garlic.

Heat half the vegetable oil in a wok over a high heat and stir-fry the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until cooked through and lightly browned. Push it to one side, pour in the egg and stir until just set.
Add the rest of the oil, the garlic and the cold cooked rice and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, breaking up any clumps, adding the frozen peas for the last 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil and spring onions, toss everything together and serve.
notes: The egg fried rice method with chicken added and one egg instead of two.

name: Prawn fried rice
summary: Egg fried rice with juicy stir-fried prawns.
method: Pat the peeled prawns dry. Beat the egg, slice the spring onions and grate the garlic and ginger.

Heat half the vegetable oil in a wok over a high heat and stir-fry the prawns for 2 to 3 minutes until pink all over; tip onto a plate. Pour the egg into the wok and stir until just set, then add it to the prawns.
Add the rest of the oil, the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add the cold cooked rice and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, adding the frozen peas for the last 2 minutes.
Return the prawns and egg, add the soy sauce, sesame oil and spring onions and toss until hot.
notes: Weigh the prawns peeled. The egg fried rice method with prawns added and one egg instead of two.

name: Tofu fried rice
summary: Fried rice with crisp golden tofu cubes in place of the egg, plus carrot and peas.
method: Press the tofu between kitchen paper for 10 minutes, then cut it into small cubes. Dice the carrot, slice the spring onions and crush the garlic.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a wok over a medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until golden on all sides; lift out.
Add the rest of the oil, the carrot and garlic and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add the cold cooked rice and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, adding the frozen peas for the last 2 minutes.
Return the tofu, add the soy sauce, sesame oil and spring onions and toss until hot.
notes: The egg fried rice method with tofu in place of the eggs.

name: Vegetable fried rice
summary: Fried rice packed with carrot, red pepper, peas and sweetcorn instead of egg.
method: Dice the carrot and red pepper, slice the spring onions and crush the garlic.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over a high heat and stir-fry the carrot and red pepper for 3 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the cold cooked rice and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, breaking up any clumps, adding the frozen peas and sweetcorn for the last 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil and spring onions and toss until everything is hot.
notes: The egg fried rice method with extra vegetables in place of the eggs.

name: Mushroom risotto
summary: Creamy risotto with browned chestnut mushrooms, finished with butter and Parmesan.
method: Bring the stock to a gentle simmer in a saucepan. Slice the mushrooms and finely chop the onion and garlic.

Heat the olive oil and half the butter in a wide pan and fry the mushrooms over a high heat for 5 minutes until browned; lift out. Lower the heat, add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the dry risotto rice for 1 minute until the grains look glossy. Add the white wine, if using, and let it bubble away.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and letting each addition be absorbed before the next, for 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is creamy and just tender.
Stir in the mushrooms, the rest of the butter, the Parmesan and black pepper, rest for 2 minutes, then scatter over the parsley.
notes: Ready-made stock is already salted, so taste before adding any salt. You may not need all the stock.

name: Chicken risotto
summary: Creamy Parmesan risotto with browned chicken thigh pieces, cooked in chicken stock.
method: Bring the stock to a gentle simmer in a saucepan. Cut the chicken thighs into bite-size pieces and finely chop the onion and garlic.

Heat the olive oil and half the butter in a wide pan and brown the chicken for 6 to 7 minutes; lift out. Lower the heat, add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the dry risotto rice for 1 minute until glossy. Add the white wine, if using, and let it bubble away.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring often, for 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is creamy and just tender, returning the chicken for the last 5 minutes so it cooks through.
Stir in the rest of the butter, the Parmesan and black pepper, rest for 2 minutes and scatter over the parsley.
notes: The mushroom risotto method with chicken thighs and chicken stock in place of the mushrooms and vegetable stock.

name: Pea risotto
summary: Parmesan risotto with sweet peas, fresh mint and a squeeze of lemon.
method: Bring the stock to a gentle simmer in a saucepan. Finely chop the onion and garlic.

Heat the olive oil and half the butter in a wide pan and soften the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute. Stir in the dry risotto rice for 1 minute until glossy and add the white wine, if using.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring often, for 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is creamy and just tender, adding the frozen peas for the last 4 minutes.
Stir in the rest of the butter, the Parmesan, chopped mint, lemon juice and black pepper, and rest for 2 minutes before serving.
notes: The mushroom risotto method with peas, mint and lemon in place of the mushrooms.

name: Tomato risotto
summary: Risotto cooked in passata and stock, with blistered cherry tomatoes, basil and Parmesan.
method: Warm the passata and stock together in a saucepan. Finely chop the onion and garlic.

Heat the olive oil in a wide pan and fry the cherry tomatoes over a high heat for 3 to 4 minutes until blistered; lift out. Add the butter and soften the onion for 5 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the dry risotto rice for 1 minute, then add the hot tomato stock a ladle at a time, stirring often, for 18 to 20 minutes until creamy and just tender.
Stir in the Parmesan and black pepper, top with the cherry tomatoes and torn basil, and rest for 2 minutes before serving.
notes: The mushroom risotto method with passata in the stock and cherry tomatoes in place of the mushrooms.

name: Rice and beans
summary: Long-grain rice simmered with kidney beans, coconut milk, spring onions and thyme.
method: Rinse the dry rice until the water runs clear. Finely chop the onion, garlic and spring onions.
Heat the vegetable oil in a lidded saucepan and soften the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, spring onions and dried thyme for 1 minute.

Add the rice, drained kidney beans, coconut milk, salt, black pepper and 350 ml water. Bring to the boil, stir once, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 15 to 18 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Leave covered off the heat for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
notes: The water is absorbed by the rice and adds nothing to the nutrition, so it is not listed.

name: Lentils and rice
summary: Brown lentils and basmati rice cooked together with cumin, topped with slowly browned onions.
method: Rinse the dry lentils, cover them generously with water in a saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 15 minutes until starting to soften, then drain.

Meanwhile, slice the onions thinly. Heat the olive oil in a wide lidded pan and cook the onions over a medium heat for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring often, until deep golden brown. Lift out half for the topping.

Stir the ground cumin and cinnamon into the onions left in the pan, then add the rinsed dry rice, the part-cooked lentils, the salt, black pepper and 450 ml water. Bring to the boil, cover and cook on a low heat for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Rest covered for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork and serve topped with the reserved onions and the yogurt if you like.
notes: In the style of mujaddara. The cooking water is absorbed and adds nothing to the nutrition.

name: Chicken pilaf
summary: One-pot spiced basmati rice with browned chicken thighs, carrot and onion, cooked in stock.
method: Cut the chicken thighs into bite-size pieces. Chop the onion, crush the garlic and dice the carrot. Rinse the dry rice in a sieve until the water runs clear.

Heat the olive oil in a wide lidded pan and brown the chicken for 5 minutes. Add the onion and carrot and cook for 5 minutes more, then stir in the garlic, cumin, cinnamon, turmeric and bay leaves for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice to coat it in the spices, pour in the stock, add the black pepper and bring to the boil. Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 15 minutes.
Turn off the heat and leave covered for 10 minutes. Remove the bay leaves, fluff with a fork and scatter with the parsley.
notes: Ready-made stock is salted, so no extra salt is listed.

name: Vegetable pilaf
summary: Spiced basmati pilaf with carrot, red pepper, courgette and peas, cooked in vegetable stock.
method: Chop the onion, crush the garlic and dice the carrot, red pepper and courgette. Rinse the dry rice in a sieve until the water runs clear.

Heat the olive oil in a wide lidded pan and cook the onion, carrot and red pepper for 6 minutes. Add the courgette for 2 minutes, then stir in the garlic, cumin, cinnamon, turmeric and bay leaves for 1 minute.

Stir in the rice, pour in the stock, add the black pepper and bring to the boil. Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then scatter the frozen peas over the top, cover again and cook for 3 minutes more.
Leave covered off the heat for 10 minutes. Remove the bay leaves, fluff with a fork and scatter with the parsley.
notes: The chicken pilaf method with vegetables and vegetable stock in place of the chicken and chicken stock.

name: Chicken biryani-style rice
summary: Spiced yogurt-marinated chicken layered with part-cooked basmati rice, fried onions and herbs, then steamed.
method: Cut the chicken thighs into large pieces and mix with the yogurt, grated garlic and ginger, chilli powder, cumin, ground coriander, turmeric and salt. Leave for at least 20 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Slice the onions thinly. Heat the vegetable oil in a large, heavy lidded pan and fry the onions for 15 to 20 minutes until deep golden. Lift out half for the top.
Add the chicken and its marinade to the pan with the cardamom, cinnamon, ground cloves and bay leaves and cook for 10 minutes, stirring, until the chicken is sealed and the sauce has thickened.
Meanwhile, rinse the dry rice and boil it in plenty of water for 5 minutes, then drain; it should still be firm in the middle.

Spread the rice over the chicken, sprinkle over the lemon juice, the reserved onions, fresh coriander and mint, cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 20 to 25 minutes until the rice is tender and the chicken cooked through. Fluff gently before serving.
notes: A biryani-style home version made with ground spices, not a traditional biryani. Garam masala is not in the catalogue, so the warm spices are listed one by one.

name: Vegetable biryani-style rice
summary: Spiced yogurt-coated potato, cauliflower, carrot and peas layered with basmati rice, fried onions and herbs.
method: Peel the potatoes and cut them, the cauliflower and carrots into bite-size pieces. Mix with the yogurt, grated garlic and ginger, chilli powder, cumin, ground coriander, turmeric and salt.
Slice the onions thinly. Heat the vegetable oil in a large, heavy lidded pan and fry the onions for 15 to 20 minutes until deep golden. Lift out half for the top.

Add the spiced vegetables to the pan with the cardamom, cinnamon, ground cloves, bay leaves and 100 ml water, cover and cook for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the potatoes are almost tender. Stir in the frozen peas.
Meanwhile, rinse the dry rice and boil it in plenty of water for 5 minutes, then drain; it should still be firm in the middle.

Spread the rice over the vegetables, sprinkle over the lemon juice, the reserved onions, fresh coriander and mint, cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes until the rice is tender. Fluff gently before serving.
notes: The chicken biryani-style method with potato, cauliflower, carrot and peas in place of the chicken.

name: Burrito bowl
summary: Spiced chicken, rice, black beans and sweetcorn in a bowl with fresh tomato salsa, avocado and lettuce.
method: Boil the dry rice in plenty of water for 10 to 12 minutes until tender, then drain.

Slice the chicken breast into strips and toss with the paprika, cumin, chilli powder, garlic powder and salt. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan and cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through.
Warm the black beans and sweetcorn in a small pan or the microwave.
Dice the tomatoes and red onion and mix with half the coriander and half the lime juice for a quick salsa. Slice the avocado and shred the lettuce.

Build two bowls with the rice, lettuce, chicken, beans, sweetcorn, salsa and avocado, squeeze over the rest of the lime juice, scatter with the rest of the coriander and add the grated cheddar and soured cream if you like.

name: Salmon rice bowl
summary: Soy and honey glazed salmon over jasmine rice with quick-pickled cucumber, edamame and avocado.
method: Rinse the dry rice and put it in a lidded saucepan with 210 ml water. Bring to the boil, cover and cook on a low heat for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat for 5 minutes.
Mix the soy sauce, honey and grated ginger. Slice the cucumber thinly and toss with the cider vinegar.

Heat the vegetable oil in a non-stick frying pan and cook the salmon fillets for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until just cooked through. Pour in half the soy mixture and let it bubble for 1 minute, spooning it over the fish.
Cook the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes and drain. Slice the avocado and spring onions.

Divide the rice between two bowls, top with the salmon, cucumber, edamame and avocado, drizzle with the rest of the soy mixture and the sesame oil, and scatter with the spring onions and sesame seeds.
notes: Weigh the salmon without skin. Rice vinegar is not in the catalogue, so cider vinegar pickles the cucumber.

name: Couscous vegetable bowl
summary: Herby lemon couscous topped with spiced pan-fried courgette, pepper, red onion and chickpeas.
method: Put the dry couscous in a bowl, pour over the hot stock, cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

Cut the courgette, red pepper and red onion into bite-size pieces. Heat 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a large frying pan and cook the vegetables over a medium-high heat for 8 to 10 minutes until browned and tender.
Add the chickpeas, cumin, paprika, cinnamon and salt and cook for 2 minutes more.
Stir the rest of the olive oil, the lemon juice and the chopped parsley and mint through the couscous. Top with the vegetables and chickpeas and crumble over the feta if you like.

name: Quinoa roast vegetable bowl
summary: Quinoa with roast sweet potato, broccoli and red onion, rocket, feta and a lemon tahini dressing.
method: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cut the sweet potato into 2 cm cubes and the red onion into wedges, toss with two-thirds of the olive oil, the paprika and salt on a tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Cut the broccoli into florets, toss with the rest of the oil, add to the tray and roast for 15 minutes more until everything is tender and browned at the edges.
Meanwhile, rinse the dry quinoa and simmer it in plenty of water for 12 to 15 minutes until the grains show a little tail, then drain well.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice and the 20 ml water until smooth and pourable.
Divide the quinoa and rocket between two bowls, add the roast vegetables, crumble over the feta, scatter with the pumpkin seeds and drizzle with the tahini dressing.

name: Chicken and chorizo rice
summary: One-pan paella-style rice with chicken thighs, cooking chorizo, red pepper and peas.
method: Cut the chicken thighs into chunks and slice the chorizo. Chop the onion and red pepper and crush the garlic.

Heat the olive oil in a large, deep frying pan and brown the chicken and chorizo for 6 to 8 minutes. Add the onion and red pepper and cook for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the garlic, paprika and turmeric for 1 minute.
Stir in the dry rice, then add the chopped tomatoes and hot stock. Bring to the boil and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes without stirring.
Scatter over the frozen peas, cover with a lid or foil and cook for 5 minutes more until the rice is tender and the liquid absorbed. Squeeze over the lemon juice and scatter with the parsley.
notes: Paella-style rather than a traditional paella. Uses fresh cooking chorizo; cured chorizo is not in the catalogue.
